HENDERSON CASTLE
once upon a time...
there was a magical place where people of all ages could escape. A very enchanting place where the food was delectable, the atmosphere was mystical and the people were wonderful. Imagine a place like this where you could go to Relax, Rejuvenate, Dine like Royalty, and Forget your Everyday Challenges... at least for a moment in time. Well, this is not a fairytale, there actually is such a place!
"Welcome to the Henderson Castle, a real-life castle like no other. The Henderson Castle sits atop a hill overlooking Kalamazoo, Michigan. Easily accessible from all around the midwest, this extraordinary venue is the perfect place to treat yourself, your family, or your friends to a day or two (or a week if you prefer) where time stands still and your problems melt away. Come to the Castle and celebrate Anniversaries, Birthdays, Weddings, Graduations, Relationships, or better yet... Celebrate Life! The Henderson Castle is also the perfect Romantic Getaway Destination! Situated in the Historic West Main Hill neighborhood, minutes away from downtown Kalamazoo.

When you're with us, you'll have a memorable experience. Wake up to an incredible breakfast prepared just for you. Treat yourself to a relaxing massage or facial in our day spa and soak in our rooftop hot tub while taking in the best view of Kalamazoo. Make reservations for dinner at our restaurant, h CHOP HOUSE, and indulge in a unique chophouse experience. In addition, we offer a variety of venue spaces that can accommodate ceremonies, corporate meetings, holiday parties, family events, baby showers, and more. Our daily Tours, the Queen's Tea Service, Wine Tastings, and monthly Princess Tea Parties (as well as Murder Mystery Dinners). It's all just the beginning of a list of fun things to do in Kalamazoo. Why settle for a hotel when you can spend the weekend in a Castle? Space is limited so reserve your spot today! 

STAYING
at HENDERSON CASTLE
The Henderson Castle delivers guests the best Bed and Breakfast experience in Michigan ... and in fact, one of the best Bed and Breakfast experiences in America . When you approach the Castle you see it perched elegantly on a hill surrounded by shrubbery, grape vines and flowers. As you make your way up the curved driveway you know that you are about to partake on a special journey. The Castle itself brings a fairytale-like ambiance... just like it has since President Grover Cleveland oversaw the country back in 1895.
When you stay at the Castle you have your choice of several rooms... all that provide guests a different ambiance and experience. In addition to our rooms, we offer guests several other accommodations such as meeting areas, Spa Services, a Fine Dining Restaurant, a Wine Cave, and much more. If you want a totally special experience, come stay with us at the Henderson Castle in Kalamazoo, Michigan and let our staff deliver you a little bit of royalty.
Complimentary, American a la carte breakfast for 2 is provided with rooms each morning 8:00 am - 9:30 am
Guests receive a $20 dining credit toward dinner at h CHOP HOUSE Restaurant (when purchasing 2 or more entrees)
(No Cash Value. Limit one per stay. Complimentary credits cannot be combined with other discounts or promotions. Valid only during regular restaurant hours.
Please note: The state of Michigan has made it a crime to bring alcoholic beverages into your room unless they are purchased onsite.

HENDERSON CASTLE
FAQs
What is Henderson Castle?
Henderson Castle is a historic luxury estate in Kalamazoo, Michigan, offering fine dining, overnight accommodations, wine tasting, high tea, spa experiences, weddings, and private events.
Do you have to stay overnight to dine at H Chophouse?
No. H Chophouse is open to the public 7 days a week. Guests are welcome to enjoy dinner reservations without booking a hotel stay at: https://tableagent.com/kalamazoo-portage/n-prime-chophouse
Does Henderson Castle offer wine tasting?
Yes. Henderson Castle offers daily wine tasting experiences from 12 8pm and wine flights featuring red and white selections.
Does Henderson Castle offer High Tea?
Yes. Guests can enjoy elegant high tea experiences with tea selections, pastries, savory bites, and a historic castle atmosphere daily from 11 2pm.
Can I tour Henderson Castle?
Yes. Henderson Castle offers daily self-guided tours and select guest experiences that allow visitors to explore the historic property 7 days a week from 12 3pm.
Does Henderson Castle host weddings and private events?
Yes. Henderson Castle hosts weddings, rehearsal dinners, bridal showers, corporate events, celebrations, and private gatherings; email hendersoncastlemanager@gmail.com
Does Henderson Castle have overnight accommodations?
Yes. Henderson Castle offers 11 unique guest rooms and suites inside the historic estate, 2 main-level overnight cottages located on the property, and 8 rooms located at our sister property Upjohn Inn.
Does Henderson Castle have a spa?
Yes. Spa services may include massages, facials, beauty treatments, and wellness experiences.
Where is Henderson Castle located?
Henderson Castle is located in Kalamazoo, Michigan and welcomes both locals and travelers.
How do I make reservations?
Reservations can be made through Henderson Castle's website, online booking systems, or by contacting the property directly: hendersoncastle.com or 269-344-1827.

wikipedia.title: Henderson Castle (Kalamazoo)
wikipedia.extract: Henderson Castle, built in 1895, is a large privately owned home located on the steep West Main Hill overlooking downtown Kalamazoo, Michigan. The castle has been recently renovated and is under new ownership. The building is open to the public.
